title: Hypothesis: any third party can reproduce the Protean Ledger state digest from genesis using only the deployed contract and a public Base RPC, with no dependency on Protean infrastructure.
summary: The deployed indexer code is public and stateless beyond the SQLite database; the canonical-bytes serialization is RFC 8785 with a single bytea-hex local rule; event ordering is total over (block, log_index); record IDs are content-addressed. Third-party reproduction is the architectural test of independence. This hypothesis is falsifiable by demonstrating divergent digests from identical inputs.
author: Protean Labs

verifiedBy.verificationDescription: Fresh SQLite database, no Protean state on disk. Ran scripts/index_ledger_from_genesis.py from genesis. Digest reproduced byte-for-byte. Hypothesis verified by behavior immediately after registration; reverification possible at any time using the canonical script in this mirror.
